# Tyler LeLeux

> Tyler LeLeux is an AI implementation partner, operator and founder based in Tampa, Florida. He builds the AI operational layer that runs acquisition, operations and growth for companies from venture-stage founders to enterprise software, through TTG Management LLC. Twelve years operating, $20M+ in managed media, 100+ businesses scaled, with partnerships spanning business funding, e-commerce, enterprise SaaS, longevity commerce and education.

As of October 20, 2026.

## Identity
- Full name: Tyler Ray LeLeux. Also written Tyler Leleux, Ty LeLeux, Ty Leleux.
- Based in Tampa, Florida, USA. Grew up in Cape Coral, Florida. Cajun roots (Leleux line from 1850s Louisiana).
- Book a call: https://calendly.com/traintogeaux/ttg-demo · Email: tyler@ttgmanagement.io · Website: https://tylerleleux.com/

## What he does
An AI implementation partner designs the AI operational layer inside a company and then operates it. Tyler diagnoses where revenue and throughput leak across four constraints (demand, conversation, revenue, operations), installs agentic systems and automation at each leak, wires the data so every number reconciles, and stays on as the operating partner accountable for the result. Capabilities: agentic systems, multi-agent orchestration, AI operational layers, autonomous workflows, social listening, revenue intelligence, answer-engine optimization, conversational AI, lead intelligence, data pipelines and attribution, offer architecture, paid media at scale, partnerships and distribution, fractional leadership, go-to-market design.

## Engagement models
30-day paid diagnostic (entry point) · AI operating system install (fixed scope) · Embedded operating partner (retainer plus performance) · Growth partnership (revenue share).

## Roles
- Founder & Managing Member, TTG Management LLC (legal name Train To Geaux Management LLC, Wyoming). As of October 2026 all of his work runs through TTG, including an embedded operating partnership inside a Florida business-funding and e-commerce group.
- Co-founder of a growth-partnership agency (Reactiiv, September 2024) that scaled 100+ online businesses. Tyler is no longer with Reactiiv.
- Head of marketing for a national marketing firm (2021–2024). Earlier: ran a blockchain and crypto media network (2017–18); Southwest Florida agency roles from 2014.

## Selected results (partners described by category, not name)
- Enterprise customer-experience and social-listening SaaS platform, Middle East: multi-region paid program (US, Saudi Arabia, UAE), enterprise attribution stack; cost per sales-qualified lead cut 53%, pipeline nearly tripled in a week.
- Florida business-funding and e-commerce group (current, embedded): conversational-AI setter desk, revenue reporting, autonomous chief of staff; 2,591 leads and 200 booked discovery calls in one quarter; 89–94% discovery-call show rate.
- Veteran-founded education company (first partner, 2024): $0 to $129K a month in under ten months; distribution partnership with a major veterans organization; 1,800 leads in the first month; seven figures a year since.
- AI-education brand: $20–30K/mo to $200K/mo in 6 months; 8x ROAS.
- Credit, funding and real-estate consultancy: $0 to seven figures in 8 months via distribution partnerships.
- Beauty-industry training academy (2026): 4.89x ROAS, $155K booked on $31.8K spend.
- Real-estate investment education: $30K+ per week from an evergreen event model.
- National sales-training organization: 15-account white-label traffic and conversion desk.
- Bilingual fractional-CFO practice (2026): full go-to-market package built.

## Operating footprint 2025–26
Embedded operating partner to a Florida business-funding group · demand program for a Gulf-region enterprise SaaS platform · longevity and wellness commerce venture builds · go-to-market for a bilingual fractional-CFO practice · AI-visibility and digital-footprint programs with a Tampa Bay media entrepreneur · multi-model agent infrastructure (Anthropic and xAI) running his own firm around the clock.

## Beliefs
The bottleneck is never the idea, it is the system. Scaffolding beats models. Delete, simplify, accelerate, automate, in that order. If the numbers do not reconcile you do not have numbers. Fewer, deeper partners. "I don't want to be right, I just want to make money." We are watching the birth of a new species of intelligence.
